policy: Models are eligible only inside each provider's reviewed family. Antigravity is restricted to the reviewed Gemini family and Claude to sonnet and haiku; opus is not spent on routine cadence. ChatGPT is reached through the signed-in Codex CLI and restricted to Luna, Terra and Sol. A stale catalogue health result may trigger one real live probe, but every model must first pass the offline empty-tool qualification; production runs are ephemeral, read-only, schema-constrained, and reject any tool event. Codex runs at a three-hour family interval, with Luna preferred for routine observations and Terra/Sol as measured fallbacks. One attempt per five-minute tick; at least 30 minutes between accepted monologues, at most 72 attempts per UTC day and 24 per route family. Failed models cool down; account quota errors also defer sibling models. Every attempt and complete response is retained. No catch-up bursts. Hourly output remains an availability target.
